notes: A third agent mode joins build and plan: TEST. `tagent test` (or `/test` in the TUI, or the Test button in the GUI) turns the agent into a QA engineer for your project — it boots the app itself, clicks through it with a real browser, checks responsiveness and typography, and writes TEST-REPORT.md with a pass/warn/fail verdict. Screenshots are attached to the model’s context when the model can see images, so the agent JUDGES the UI instead of guessing. Also fixes a real bug in the old browser tool (it could never launch a page at all).
